snippet.title: Hashtag Bacon A Quickplay Game For iPhone
snippet.description:
Hashtag Bacon for iPhone. Tap and jump over the little pigs. Avoid the springs and see how long you can last.

iTunes Link:
https://itunes.apple.com/gb/app/hashtag-bacon/id909836109?mt=8

Music:
